description: Dated contract changes in widely used public APIs (Stripe, GitHub, OpenAI, Twilio, Slack, Plaid, Datadog and more), from their published OpenAPI descriptions read daily: operations, parameters and request fields added, removed or newly required, each change marked breaking or not. Last 1 to 90 days, one API with api=, or only breaking changes with breaking=true. Signed. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (Base or Solana).
